description: (Na)₂LiBiF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiBiF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a distorted cuboctahedral geometry to  atoms. In the LiBiF₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form LiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-F bond lengths are 2.03 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form BiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Bi atom.
